checklist.text: the Issuer is eligible to make an issue under SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018 and is in compliance with Regulation 5 and 7 of said regulations.

In case of offer for sale of shares in proposed IPO by the existing shareholders, the selling shareholders shall be in compliance with the Additional Conditions for an Offer for Sale as per SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018;
the post issue paid-up equity capital shall not be less than INR 10 Crores and the market capitalization shall not be less than INR 25 crores;

the net worth of the Issuer is positive; (In case of net worth being negative, confirm as follows: the issue size shall be more than Rs. 500 crores, out of which at least Rs.100 crores shall be fresh issue)
The issuer is in compliance with all the eligibility criteria of the Exchange for listing on Main Board.

the issuer has adhered to the conditions precedent to listing under Securities Contracts (Regulations) Act 1956, Companies Act 2013, RBI Guidelines, Securities and Exchange Board of India Act 1992, any rules and/or regulations framed and circulars, clarifications, guidelines issued, under foregoing statutes; and no statutory authority has restrained the issuer from issuing its securities to public through IPO.
